title: trouble's proofs measure only trouble: the raise reaches its published store, and the readers' teeth leave
intention: Three teeth in trouble's proofs measure other devices: the cairn device's log sweep (test_location_is_liveness.py:125), the cairn pane and the web_server socket rows (test_trouble_never_rides_the_bus.py:301-302) and the cairn pane's probe (:373). They leave trouble's proofs; the web server's half already berths in web_server's proofs (609b038a1958), and the cairn halves go to the cairn device's proofs in their own ticket. What trouble itself owes the end-to-end lane, a raise poked and folded into the store its published tool reads inside the 1s budget, becomes a tooth here.
why: Measured 2026-11-11: the build inspector's encapsulation_holds trouble names cairn/devices/trouble/proofs/test_location_is_liveness.py:125 (cairn.devices.cairn.logs_sweep) and cairn/devices/trouble/proofs/test_trouble_never_rides_the_bus.py:301,302,373 (the cairn device, web_server's listener, the cairn probe). RULE 1: a ticket's proofs measure only that component.
traces_to: CLAUDE.md RULE 1; outline 2.3.7.1 (trouble publishes its store tool; readers read through it); outline 17.13.1.
how: test_location_is_liveness.py: the store-root tooth keeps its address asserts and drops the sweep call. test_trouble_never_rides_the_bus.py: test_the_two_readers_read_with_no_bus, test_the_pane_probe_reads_with_no_bus and the _NoBus helper go; its docstring points at where the readers' teeth berth. New proof cairn/devices/trouble/proofs/test_trouble_proofs_measure_only_trouble.py: the sieve tooth, the forbidden-module tooth, a timed raise to store tooth (DiagnosticBase raiser, TroubleShim.receive_raise as notifier, tools.store.store.live over the same roots, under 1s) and a second-raise-folds tooth.
